title: Run event ledger line
description: One line of runs/<runId>/events.jsonl — the structured twin of a run.log line, appended by runner/log.js from the same timestamp (DESIGN.md 4.12, change-log rows `events-ledger-design` and `repo-qzy`). A line with a string `msg` has a run.log line at the same index; a line with `msg: null` is ledger-only and was never echoed. The envelope is CLOSED: a reader may rely on these eight keys and nothing else appearing.

ts.description: The single instant both records share. Not two clock reads.

level.description: The run.log level of the twin line. Ledger-only events are always INFO.

issueId.description: The trace's tail after '<runId>/'. Null for the `preflight` and `feed` pseudo-tasks, which are run-level work rather than Beads issues, and null when there is no trace.

trace.description: The trace id as run.log prints it between brackets, or null.

event.description: The event name. Enumerated INLINE rather than behind a $ref: this is the list a reader validates against, and one indirection is one more thing a hand-written validator — the kind the frozen suites use, with no dependencies — has to resolve before it can say yes or no.

msg.description: Byte-identical to the run.log line's message, or null for a ledger-only event.

data.description: The event's typed fields. Empty for `log`. $defs.events is a MAP keyed by event name and holds nothing else — every one of its keys is a member of the event enum — so a reader can look a shape up directly.

log.description: A run.log line whose call site named no event. Empty data by construction — nothing infers an event from a message prefix.

path.description: The target working copy the per-project run lock is held for (4.12).
The target working copy whose lock was left by a run whose process is gone.

queue.read.description: RESERVED. Declared here so the vocabulary is settled, and emitted by the task that carries every refusal into the ledger; nothing writes it yet. Its fields are not required, so the emitting task can widen them without a schema-versioning problem.

undispatchable.description: One entry per issue the freeze gate refused, with the reason.

priority.description: The issue's priority, or 2 when it carries none — the number the line printed.

dir.description: The per-task clone on the host.

branch.description: The task branch, task/<issueId> unless one already existed on the remote.

forkPoint.description: The FULL fork-point commit. run.log abbreviates it to eight characters for a human; the ledger does not, because a later reader may not have the repository to resolve it against.

name.description: The docker container name — unique across relaunches (4.7).

budgetMinutes.description: Remaining ACTIVE wall-clock budget for this launch; paused time never counts (4.6).

killed.description: True when the host wall-clock timer killed it at budget.

activeSeconds.description: Active total for the task across every relaunch so far.

pause.description: This TASK's relaunch count. The run-level wait-cycle count is a different quantity and lives on park.opened (7).

cycles.description: Run-level wait cycles already spent when this wait opened.

max.description: The run-level cap (config.js DEFAULTS.maxPauseCycles unless overridden).

park.reopened.description: The shared run-level wait ended and the window is open again.

until.description: The reset time the container reported. Recorded as the string it was reported as — an unparseable one is evidence, not a reason to record nothing.

exitCode.description: The container's exit code; the string 'killed' when the host timer fired and there is none (4.11), and null when a signal ended it without one.

outcome.description: The 4.11 outcome: done, partial, failed, stuck, tampered, paused.

beads.description: The Beads transition the outcome carries, or null when the issue stays in_progress.

dir.description: The run folder holding every artifact, including this ledger.

task.refused.description: The run-level rate-limit cap had already fired, so this task never launched: Beads is untouched and the issue stays open (7).

task.relaunched.description: A parked task resuming in a fresh container against the same workspace; the attempt counter carries over.

feed.on.description: The live queue feed is on for this run (4.12, change-log row `live-queue-feed`).

added.description: Issues this poll added that the run had not already dispatched.

polls.description: Re-reads of the ready queue over the whole run.

ending.description: How the feed closed — the runner/feed.js ENDINGS vocabulary, normalised the same way run.json's feed block normalises it.
